prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Input image is the ORIGINAL Stunts game portrait crop (74x79 pixels). Reconstruct this SAME portrait as a clean coherent REALISTIC PHOTOGRAPH, with plausible new detail filling the missing resolution. It is intended for a 4x restoration pass (photo interior 296x316 pixels), then will be reduced to half size and converted to game-palette pixel art. You may render larger for quality, but keep the same 74:79 canvas proportions and precise original composition.

Use imagination to resolve real facial anatomy, clear eyes, lip/tooth structure, hair strands, clothing folds and accessory construction from the original, while retaining ALL identifying details. Keep the SAME exact head angle, gaze, facial expression, face shape, hair silhouette, clothing, jewelry/eyewear and their placements, shoulder crop and subject scale. No new accessories or invented costume; no beauty makeover, expression change or camera repositioning. This should feel like recovering the original photograph behind the digitized game portrait.

Crucial quality: smooth coherent natural photographic forms and believable detail, not interpolated blocks or sharpened source noise. Render real skin with subtle pores and natural shading, clean hair strands and cloth texture. Do NOT render pixel art yet. NO dithering, grid, mosaic, pixel clusters, random texture, artificial grain, skin speckles, crispy edge halos or original-pixel anchoring. The palette/pixel-art conversion is a separate later step.

Match the original crop edge for edge, preserve flat even portrait lighting and original overall skin/clothing colors. Background must be perfectly uniform SOLID specified color, no gradients, shadows, vignette, halo, texture, noise, patterns or objects. No text, numeral, frame, border, clipboard or watermark; the original game border/number will be restored separately.


Opponent 5, Helen: front-facing woman with long, very voluminous golden blonde curls framing both sides, same broad open toothy smile and direct gaze. White collared blouse, same shoulder/neckline crop and original face shape. Background RGB (255,186,255), uniformly solid light pink. Preserve the original distinctive face and expression, not a generic model.

Restoration cleanup: remove stray pixel noise, compression/digitization speckles and isolated accidental colored dots in the original. Do not reproduce those artifacts as skin spots or cloth grain. Keep intentional patterned fabric, hair, eyebrows and defining facial features.
